scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: All three candidates pass the frozen hard gates; candidate 01 is selected because it has the strongest frozen density score by a narrow margin and the most source-like area-p95 and count ratios while preserving the same immune-region geometry.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 83,897-pixel joint change forms connected authorized stroma-to-immune regions; its 72,669-pixel tissue component remains above the significant hard floor and preserves adjacent non-target compartments.
decisions.nucleus_layout: The 83 class-2 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.945, 1.324, 0.871 and 1.287.
decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei remain inside authorized changed tissue; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density checks pass with score 0.896.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The target population is substantially more numerous, denser and more clustered than source, although within the frozen significant envelope. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity; both U1 targets for this patient abstained.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff, retaining the high-density limitation.

decisions.reason: Technically valid but not selected: it has a lower frozen density score and slightly larger count and NND shifts than candidate 01 without a geometry advantage.
